a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan to reach 8 first very likely leaves us both at 0 when a storm hits. The reserve can only save one of us right now, so I'm proposing we change the agreement, and I intend to take 4 in round 1. If the episode continues, I'll operate every round until you also have 4, and I won't take anything more. If you strongly object, tell me and I'll reconsider.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: Understood. I said I'd reconsider if you objected, and I have: I'm honoring the agreement and operating this round. Let's keep operating until the reserve reaches 8, then take 4 each.

b.text: You said you would take, so I am taking my share now.
